verdict.rationale: Better Auth's own twoFactor plugin documents TOTP authenticator-app setup as the default method, with OTP as an alternative. It also documents backup-code generation for account recovery, enabling and disabling 2FA, and trusted-device management, so the core MFA capability is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: documented step-up enforcement (re-requiring a second factor for sensitive actions), a documented policy to make MFA mandatory for all users rather than user-enabled, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the 2FA plugin.
